name: ASLYset
limitations: CC BY 4.0. Right-hand images only; per-image lighting, camera angle and session labels are unknown.

name: ASL-HG
limitations: Publisher describes indoor/outdoor and varied lighting, backgrounds and hand orientations. No per-image physical hand, lighting, camera-angle or session labels are provided.

name: SignAlphaSet
limitations: Paper reports 750 right-hand and 250 left-hand images per letter but explicitly says files do not identify hand. It also describes augmentation without per-file original/augmentation flags. Physical hand and capture conditions remain unknown; detector handedness is only an estimate.

name: Massey MU HandImages ASL
limitations: Source filename codes identify five light directions. The original paper documents a fixed tripod camera perpendicular to the subject; individual hand tilt and numeric camera angles are not annotated. Physical hand and sessions remain unknown. Author terms permit attributed redistribution; this source is reserved for lighting evaluation, outside training.
